# API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_api_reference.py from the code. Do not edit by hand: run
     `python scripts/gen_api_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

br0kr has two API surfaces: the MCP gateway agents use, and the dashboard's HTTP API operators use.
This page lists both, generated from the code, so a tool, parameter, tier or route can't be missing
from it. `scripts/br0kr_mcp_call.py` calls any tool from a shell or a CI job.

## MCP tools

The gateway agents connect to. Each tool needs a token of at least its tier: read < consume < provision;
operator tools need an operator token. A tenant token always acts on its own project. Connecting:
[connecting-an-agent.md](runbooks/connecting-an-agent.md); the operator tier:
[operator-tier.md](runbooks/operator-tier.md).

| Tool | Tier | Served by | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`cluster_capacity`](#cluster_capacity) | read | all gateways | Current free capacity across a whole cluster (sum of its nodes, derived live) so you can pick a cluster with room before choosing a node in it. |
| [`fleet_stats`](#fleet_stats) | read | all gateways | Fleet-wide admission health — shared infrastructure (like list_nodes), not per-tenant: the current admission-queue depth, the oldest waiting request's age, and admission-latency percentiles over the last hour — queue-wait (created→admitted, time spent in line) and provision latency (admitted→active). |
| [`lease_status`](#lease_status) | read | all gateways | Look up a lease's current state (PENDING=queued/waiting, ADMITTED=reserved, ACTIVE=provisioned, RELEASING/RELEASED/REJECTED/RELEASE_FAILED=on the way out) AND its VM-access connection facts. |
| [`lease_statuses`](#lease_statuses) | read | all gateways | Look up MANY leases' state + VM-access connection facts in one call — the bulk form of lease_status (so an agent that provisioned several VMs gets all their ip/vmid/state at once). |
| [`list_clusters`](#list_clusters) | read | all gateways | Inventory EVERY cluster at once: per-cluster cpu/mem used-vs-total (summed across its nodes), node count, and live lease count. |
| [`list_leases`](#list_leases) | read | all gateways | List YOUR project's ACTIVE leases — the ones currently HOLDING capacity (ADMITTED/PROVISIONING/ACTIVE/RELEASING), oldest-first (up to `limit`). |
| [`list_nodes`](#list_nodes) | read | all gateways | Inventory EVERY node at once (not just one by id): each node's cpu/mem used-vs-total, utilization %, live lease count, and its cluster (null = unassigned/capacity-only). |
| [`list_projects`](#list_projects) | read | all gateways | Inventory YOUR project (tenant): cpu/mem/lease quota vs live usage, plus your current admission-queue depth. |
| [`list_storage`](#list_storage) | read | all gateways | Inventory EVERY shared-storage pool at once: disk used-vs-total and active lease count per pool. |
| [`list_templates`](#list_templates) | read | all gateways | Inventory the OS-template images YOUR project may clone: each public image PLUS any private image an operator has granted to your project (id, cluster + vmid, optional name/description). |
| [`migration_status`](#migration_status) | read | all gateways | Watch a cross-cluster MIGRATION of one of YOUR leases progress (REQUESTED → RESERVED → MIGRATING → DONE/ABORTED). |
| [`node_capacity`](#node_capacity) | read | all gateways | Current free capacity on a node (cpu + mem, derived live) so you can size a request before making it. |
| [`project_capacity`](#project_capacity) | read | all gateways | Remaining tenant budget for YOUR project (cpu + mem + how many more leases it may hold, derived live) so you can check your quota before requesting. |
| [`queue_status`](#queue_status) | read | all gateways | Check a QUEUED lease: its state and how many requests are AHEAD of it in line (its GLOBAL position across the whole queue). |
| [`queue_view`](#queue_view) | read | all gateways | View YOUR project's admission queue: depth plus the oldest-first head of your waiting requests (up to `limit`), each with its position, how long it has waited, time left before its wait ceiling, the ask (target node/cluster, resources), and `blocked_reason` — 'node_cordoned' when a pinned request's target node has been cordoned (it won't promote until an operator uncordons it or you cancel and re-request elsewhere), else null (a null with room still waiting is transient — it will promote). |
| [`replication_status`](#replication_status) | read | all gateways | Status of a replication job: its state (REQUESTED → COPYING → CONVERTING → READY \| FAILED), mechanism, attempts, any (pre-redacted) error, the target (cluster/storage), the declared size, `replication_enabled` (whether the data plane is advancing jobs yet), and `age_seconds`. |
| [`wait_for_lease`](#wait_for_lease) | read | all gateways | Wait server-side (timeout_s, at most 60 s) until your lease reaches until_state (ADMITTED, PROVISIONING or ACTIVE; default ACTIVE) or ends, instead of polling lease_status. |
| [`whoami`](#whoami) | read | all gateways | Identify the tenant + privilege THIS token acts as — so you can confirm WHICH project the connector is bound to before you request or release anything. |
| [`cancel_lease`](#cancel_lease) | consume | all gateways | Give up a QUEUED request (or release a live lease you no longer want). |
| [`cancel_leases`](#cancel_leases) | consume | all gateways | Give up MANY queued requests (or release the live ones) in one call — the bulk form of cancel_lease. |
| [`release_lease`](#release_lease) | consume | all gateways | Release a lease when you're done so its capacity is reclaimed. |
| [`release_leases`](#release_leases) | consume | all gateways | Release MANY leases in one call (fleet shutdown) — the bulk form of release_lease. |
| [`renew_lease`](#renew_lease) | consume | all gateways | Heartbeat a lease to extend its TTL. |
| [`renew_leases`](#renew_leases) | consume | all gateways | Heartbeat MANY leases in one call (keep a whole fleet alive) — the bulk form of renew_lease. |
| [`request_lease`](#request_lease) | consume | all gateways | Reserve capacity for a VM on a node (race-free admission control). |
| [`schedule_lease`](#schedule_lease) | consume | all gateways | Reserve capacity and let the broker PICK the node for you (placement/scheduling). |
| [`request_template_download`](#request_template_download) | provision | all gateways | Download a net-new OS image and register it as a PRIVATE catalog template owned by YOUR project. |
| [`set_quota`](#set_quota) | provision | all gateways | Raise or lower YOUR project's quota within the envelope your operator set (the provision tier's self-service). |
| [`cancel_migration`](#cancel_migration) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: cancel a migration saga, releasing its held target reservation WITHOUT destroying the workload — the guest stays on the source and the lease is untouched. |
| [`cancel_replication`](#cancel_replication) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: cancel a REQUESTED replication job — it never created a guest, so this just marks it FAILED and frees the one-active slot (a copy already COPYING/CONVERTING is refused `not_cancellable`; its teardown belongs to the data-plane reclaim, a later PR). |
| [`clear_discovery_dismissal`](#clear_discovery_dismissal) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: CLEAR a discovery-finding dismissal — un-suppress a finding previously dismissed via `dismiss_discovery_finding`, so it re-surfaces in `discover_reachability` if still live. |
| [`detect_template_bridge`](#detect_template_bridge) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: report which PVE bridge a template's net0 is baked to, read from a READY instance's live config, to guide set_network_node and set_template_logical_network. |
| [`discover_reachability`](#discover_reachability) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: diff every served node's live PVE storage and bridges against br0kr's declarations. |
| [`dismiss_discovery_finding`](#dismiss_discovery_finding) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: dismiss a known-benign discover_reachability finding (e.g. a node-local scratch pool never meant to be shared), so later reports list it under `dismissed` instead of raising it again. |
| [`force_fail_build`](#force_fail_build) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: force a STUCK template-download build → FAILED, the manual escape hatch for a build the daemon's automated reclaim can't finalize (a wedged PVE / dead node whose guest DELETE keeps failing) — it would otherwise retry forever and keep pinning the owning project's declared template-disk quota reserve. |
| [`force_fail_replication`](#force_fail_replication) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: force a STUCK non-terminal replication job → FAILED WITHOUT any teardown — the manual release valve for a job whose automated reclaim keeps raising (a wedged PVE / dead node) and so keeps holding the one-active slot + the byte reservation. |
| [`list_template_instances`](#list_template_instances) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: list every template INSTANCE — the physical copies of the logical templates and WHERE each lives (cluster/node/storage/vmid), its state/origin, and whether it is bound to a placement. |
| [`mark_template_source_dirty`](#mark_template_source_dirty) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: set (`dirty=true`) or clear a template's hand-modified flag. |
| [`migrate_lease`](#migrate_lease) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: relocate a running lease's guest to a node in ANOTHER cluster, race-free: the target is reserved through admit(), then the guest moves fence-checked. |
| [`node_cordon`](#node_cordon) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: cordon (cordoned=true) or uncordon (false) a node — the "place NO new lease here" toggle. |
| [`pin_lease`](#pin_lease) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: pin (pinned=true) or unpin (false) any tenant's live lease. |
| [`prune_replications`](#prune_replications) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: retention for the replication job table — delete SETTLED TERMINAL jobs older than `older_than_days` (optionally scoped to one target cluster), so a decommissioned cluster's job history can't FK-block it forever. |
| [`replicate_template`](#replicate_template) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: request an async copy of a template onto another pool; the leader daemon copies it once `replication_enabled`. |
| [`verify_declarations`](#verify_declarations) | operator | `gateway-operator` only | OPERATOR only: reconcile DECLARED storage reachability against PVE and quarantine a (storage, node) pair on hard evidence (PVE reports the pool disabled, or its live content dropped `images`), so templated leases over it are refused until clear_storage_node_quarantine. |

## Dashboard HTTP API

The operator surface: HTTP with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, answering JSON (the page itself is
HTML; the audit export is CSV unless `?format=json`). It is not a tenant contract; agents use the MCP
tools above. **open** needs no token. **read** needs the read token, the operator token or a named
operator, but only when `BR0KR_DASHBOARD_READ_TOKEN` is set; otherwise it is open. **operator** needs
the operator token (`BR0KR_DASHBOARD_TOKEN`) or a named operator; while `BR0KR_DASHBOARD_TOKEN` is
unset, the operator routes and every action answer 403 `disabled`. Where a token is required, a
missing or wrong one is 401. Setup: [docker-deploy.md §3](runbooks/docker-deploy.md#3-bring-it-up).

### Reads (GET)

| Path | Access |
|---|---|
| `/` | open |
| `/api/audit` | operator |
| `/api/audit/export` | operator |
| `/api/clusters` | read |
| `/api/fleet` | read |
| `/api/lease/status` | read |
| `/api/leases` | read |
| `/api/ledger` | read |
| `/api/meta` | open |
| `/api/migrations` | read |
| `/api/nodes` | read |
| `/api/operators` | operator |
| `/api/overview` | read |
| `/api/projects` | read |
| `/api/queue` | read |
| `/api/replications` | read |
| `/api/settings` | operator |
| `/api/storage` | read |
| `/api/template/builds` | operator |
| `/api/template/grants` | operator |
| `/api/template/instances` | read |
| `/api/template/sources` | operator |
| `/api/templates` | read |
| `/api/tokens` | operator |
| `/api/whoami` | open |
| `/healthz` | open |
| `/assets/<version>/…` | open (the page's vendored CSS and JS) |

### Actions (POST, JSON body)

Every action needs the operator token or a named operator. An action that changes something is
recorded in the audit log.

| Path | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/api/cancel` | Cancel a lease: drop it while it is still queued, or release it (destroying its VM) once it is live. |
| `/api/cluster/create` | Create a cluster (its API connection). |
| `/api/cluster/delete` | Delete a cluster. |
| `/api/cluster/edit` | Edit a cluster's connection, READ-MODIFY-WRITE: each field is 'leave None to KEEP current' (COALESCE). |
| `/api/discovery/dismiss` | DISMISS a single discovery finding so `discover_reachability` filters it out of future reports (moved to the `dismissed` roster) — the operator's "I've seen this, stop nagging" on a KNOWN-benign drift row (e.g. a node-local `local`/`rpool` scratch pool that will never be declared shared). |
| `/api/discovery/dismissal/clear` | CLEAR a discovery-finding dismissal — un-suppress a finding the operator previously dismissed (the twin of `dismiss_discovery_finding`), so it re-surfaces in `discover_reachability` if still live. |
| `/api/instance/bind` | Bind an (unbound) template instance — a backfilled seed — to a concrete (node, storage) so it becomes placeable on a multi-node cluster. |
| `/api/instance/delete` | Delete a template-instance ROW (never the physical guest). |
| `/api/instance/retire` | Retire a READY/REPLICATING instance → RETIRED (excluded from uniqueness + 0033 usability, so a fresh copy can be materialised in its place — stale content is never immortal). |
| `/api/lease/create` | Provision a VM on behalf of `project_id` (act-as), debiting THAT project's real quota through the proven admission path. |
| `/api/lease/pin` | Pin or unpin a live lease. |
| `/api/lease/release` | Release a lease (normal completion). |
| `/api/lease/renew` | Heartbeat a lease to push its TTL out — OR hold your place in the admission QUEUE (a PENDING lease's renewable spot, capped at its max-wait ceiling). |
| `/api/migrate` | Request that a lease's running guest be migrated to ``target_node_id`` in ANOTHER cluster, race-free (br0kr/migration.py). |
| `/api/migration/cancel` | OPERATOR control plane: cancel a migration saga, releasing its held target reservation WITHOUT destroying the workload (the guest stays on the source, the lease is untouched). |
| `/api/network/create` | Declare a fleet-global LOGICAL NETWORK identity (0039 `logical_network`) — the cross-cluster-stable name a template's net0 is on (e.g. 'lan'), resolved to a concrete bridge PER NODE by `set_network_node`. |
| `/api/network/delete` | Retire a logical network. |
| `/api/network/node` | Declare which concrete PVE BRIDGE a node presents for a logical network (0039 `network_node`) — the reachability AND the rewrite target the placement gate resolves for a CROSS-NODE clone (the network twin of `set_storage_nodes`, re-keyed onto the logical identity). |
| `/api/network/node/delete` | UN-DECLARE a single (node, logical net) → bridge mapping — the narrowing 0038's declarative `set_node_bridges` gave for free (dropping a name deleted its row). |
| `/api/network/quarantine/clear` | Clear a (node, logical net) reachability QUARANTINE — an operator asserting a pair the post-clone net0 assertion fail-closed is reachable again. |
| `/api/node/cordon` | Cordon (cordoned=True) or uncordon (False) a node — the operator's "place NO new lease here" toggle. |
| `/api/node/create` | Create a node. |
| `/api/node/delete` | Delete a node. |
| `/api/node/edit` | Edit a node's capacity / cluster assignment / in-cluster name. |
| `/api/operator/create` | Mint a NAMED dashboard operator. |
| `/api/operator/revoke` | Revoke a named operator (a SOFT delete: set revoked_at, preserving the row as a record the credential existed). |
| `/api/project/create` | Create a tenant, optionally with its self-service ceilings (the `*_max` envelope; None = that dimension not self-raisable, the default — self-service is OFF until a ceiling is set). |
| `/api/project/delete` | Delete a tenant. |
| `/api/project/edit` | Set an EXISTING project's tenant budget (cpu/mem/lease limits + optional per-project queue cap) AND its self-service ceilings (the `*_max` envelope a provision token may climb within; None = that dimension not self-raisable). |
| `/api/project/max-pinned` | Set how many live leases of a project may be pinned (0 = pinning off, the default; br0kr/pin.py). |
| `/api/project/template-disk` | Set (or clear, with None) a project's template-disk ceiling — the GB of downloaded template images the tenant's provision tokens may own (phase A4.2; NULL disables self-service downloads for the tenant, the opt-in default for every new project). |
| `/api/quota` | Set ONLY a project's base quota (cpu/mem/lease limits + the optional queue cap), PRESERVING its self-service ceilings — the /api/quota base-quota editor. |
| `/api/reload` | Ask the daemon to reload its fleet config on its next tick, by setting the flag it reads and clears. |
| `/api/replication/cancel` | Cancel a REQUESTED replication job — CAS `REQUESTED → FAILED`, no teardown (a REQUESTED job never created a guest), stamping `guest_settled_at = now()` so the row is immediately prune-eligible. |
| `/api/replication/create` | Request a template replication from the DASHBOARD (act-as), the operator-GUI mirror of the MCP `replicate_template` tool. |
| `/api/replication/force-fail` | Force-fail a wedged replication job, then free its byte reservation. |
| `/api/replication/prune` | Retention: delete SETTLED TERMINAL replication jobs at least `older_than_days` old (optionally scoped to one target cluster) so a decommissioned cluster's/pool's job history can't FK-block it forever (§3.4 — the immortal-FK web). |
| `/api/settings/edit` | Apply a validated patch to the operator settings, the ledger override layer the daemon and gateway hot-apply. |
| `/api/storage/content` | Declare which PVE storage CONTENT types a pool supports (0041 `storage.content_types`) — the capability the template-build + rebuild_source seams gate on via `placement.content_capable`. |
| `/api/storage/create` | Create a shared-storage pool (a quota scope). |
| `/api/storage/delete` | Delete a storage pool. |
| `/api/storage/edit` | Edit a storage pool's size. |
| `/api/storage/node/add` | ADD a SINGLE (storage, node) reachability pair — the one-confirm widen the operator runs on a `discover_reachability` `known_pool_new_node` finding. |
| `/api/storage/node/remove` | REMOVE a SINGLE (storage, node) reachability pair — the single-pair un-declare, the twin of `delete_network_node`. |
| `/api/storage/nodes` | Declare which nodes physically reach a pool (0031 `storage_node`) — the reachability the placement gate reads. |
| `/api/storage/placement` | Bind (or re-bind) an EXISTING quota row's physical identity — for a pool created before 0031, or to correct a `pve_name`. |
| `/api/storage/quarantine/clear` | Clear a (storage, node) reachability QUARANTINE — an operator asserting a pair the post-clone assertion fail-closed is reachable again. |
| `/api/template/build/force-fail` | OPERATOR escape hatch: force a STUCK non-terminal template build → FAILED WITHOUT any teardown — the manual release valve for a build the automated reclaim can't finalize (a wedged PVE / dead node whose guest DELETE keeps failing), which otherwise retries forever and keeps pinning the owning project's declared disk-quota reserve. |
| `/api/template/build/request` | Enqueue an operator request to DOWNLOAD an image and register it as catalog template `target_template_id`. |
| `/api/template/create` | Register a cloneable OS template in the catalog. |
| `/api/template/delete` | Remove a catalog entry. |
| `/api/template/download` | Download a net-new OS image on behalf of `project_id` (act-as), debiting THAT project's template-disk quota — the operator-chosen-project mirror of the MCP `request_template_download` tool (which binds the project from the token). |
| `/api/template/edit` | Edit a catalog entry (its cluster binding, vmid, label, and `public` visibility). |
| `/api/template/grant` | Grant a project the right to select a (typically non-public) catalog template. |
| `/api/template/network` | Point (or clear) the LOGICAL NETWORK a template's net0 is on — the identity the placement gate resolves to the placement node's bridge (and rewrites net0 to) before admitting a CROSS-NODE clone of this template. |
| `/api/template/revoke` | Revoke a project's grant for a template. |
| `/api/template/source-dirty` | Set or clear a template's `source_dirty` HAND-MODIFICATION attestation. |
| `/api/template/source/create` | Add a trusted download-source PREFIX to the allowlist (a build's url must start with one — see imgbuild.source_allowed). |
| `/api/template/source/delete` | Remove a source prefix from the allowlist. |
| `/api/token/create` | Mint a token. |
| `/api/token/expiry` | Re-date (or CLEAR) an existing token's expiry — token lifecycle beyond mint-time (until now, expiry could only be set at creation). |
| `/api/token/revoke` | Revoke a token (a SOFT delete: set revoked_at, preserving the row as an audit record that the credential existed). |
